Section 17 — Compulsory merger notification (Republic Act No. 10667)

Parties to a merger or acquisition are required to notify the Philippine Competition Commission when the Size of Party (SOP) and Size of Transaction (SOT) exceed PHP 9,100,000,000 and PHP 3,800,000,000, respectively.

Both thresholds must be met for a transaction to be notifiable under Section 17 of the Philippine Competition Act, as adjusted by the PCC effective March 2026.
